# Serve Washington

> > Washington's state service commission connecting volunteers with AmeriCorps programs, seniors service opportunities, and community impact initiatives statewide.

Serve Washington administers AmeriCorps State and National grants, AmeriCorps Seniors programs including Foster Grandparents, and the Washington Climate Corps Network. The commission works under the Governor's office to promote volunteerism and civic engagement across Washington State.

## Key Topics

- AmeriCorps programs
- Volunteer opportunities
- Grant applications and funding
- AmeriCorps Seniors
- Foster Grandparent Program
- Washington Climate Corps Network (WCCN)
- Commission membership
- Community service impact
- National service programs
- Governor appointments
- Get Connected volunteer platform
- Climate resilience initiatives
- Community engagement
- Service learning
- Civic participation

## Get Involved

- [Volunteer](https://servewashington.wa.gov/volunteer): Find volunteer opportunities in Washington through Get Connected
- [Join the Commission](https://servewashington.wa.gov/about-us/join-commission): Apply to become a Serve Washington commissioner appointed by the Governor

## AmeriCorps Programs

- [Foster Grandparents Program](https://servewashington.wa.gov/americorps/seniors/foster-grandparent-program): AmeriCorps Seniors program connecting grandparents with youth mentoring
- [Consultation process for AmeriCorps National Direct programs](https://servewashington.wa.gov/funding-opportunities/consultation-process-americorps-national-direct-programs): Multi-state AmeriCorps National Direct grant consultation process guide

## Funding and Grant Resources

- [AmeriCorps grant application workshops](https://servewashington.wa.gov/news-reports/americorps-grant-application-workshops): Free online workshops on AmeriCorps grant applications with experts
- [Act now for climate resilience—join our WCCN grants webinar](https://servewashington.wa.gov/news-reports/act-now-climate-resilience-join-wccn-grants-webinar): Washington Climate Corps Network grants webinar on climate resilience

- [2023–2024 Serve Washington Annual Report](https://servewashington.wa.gov/news-reports/1013-2): Annual report on volunteerism and civic engagement for 2023-2024
